_comment: The 34 villagers of Mistria — an explicit, pinned roster.
THE PROBLEM. The Characters Cargo table has 56 rows. The other 22 are wiki
editors' user pages, which use the same Character infobox template:
ApatheticAuthor, Snuzuzu/sandbox, Character/doc, The Player/ru, 'Zel or Marin'.
No field separates them — the user pages have birthdays, occupations, species
and eye colours filled in, because people role-play in them. Without this
filter the app would list 'BlueberryBop' as a villager you can date.
WHY A LIST AND NOT A HEURISTIC. Identifying villagers by 'has gift
preferences' happens to match 34/34 today, but it is a property of the wiki
rather than of the game: an editor adding gift data to a user page, or a real
villager not having any yet, would silently change the roster. The cast of a
released game is fixed, so it is pinned here and drift is reported rather than
absorbed.
The roster matches docs/research/01-game-data.md: 12 romanceable, 14
townfolk, 8 Saturday Market vendors.
Two names to know about: 'Caldarus' and 'Priestess' are the late-game hidden
characters. The research doc calls the second one Seridia; the wiki has no
page under that name, so 'Priestess' is used as-is rather than renamed on a
guess. If the game files confirm the internal name, it gets reconciled at G1
and the old id lands in former_ids.
If the wiki adds a genuinely new villager in a patch, add the name here. The
build warns when the table contains a gift-receiving character that this list
omits, so a real addition surfaces rather than being silently dropped.
